hints: Blanking while you search rewrites the thing you are searching. What has to happen before any writing starts?
Every original zero has to be found first. The simplest fix is two sets - the rows to blank and the columns to blank - filled in one pass and applied in a second.
That is O(rows + columns) space. To do better, store those two sets *inside the grid itself*: use the first row to mark which columns to blank, and the first column for the rows.

The cell where they meet, `grid[0][0]`, would have to mean two things at once. Record whether the first column needs blanking in a single separate flag, and let `grid[0][0]` speak only for the first row.
